m: Marinade: half the yoghurt with the curry paste, garam masala, half the garlic, the juice of half the lemons and 1 tsp salt. Coat the chicken and leave at least 30 minutes (overnight is best).
Pickled onion: thinly sliced red onion with the vinegar, a pinch of sugar and salt.
Raita: the rest of the yoghurt with grated cucumber, chopped mint, the rest of the garlic and salt.
Grill or pan-fry the chicken on high, 5 to 6 minutes a side, until charred at the edges and cooked through. Rest 5 minutes.
Serve with rice, warm naan, raita, pickled onion and lemon wedges.
l: Chicken over rice with the raita in a separate container.
g: GF wraps or extra rice instead of naan. Check the curry paste label.
